proposal.summary: SAUTER Controls Nova 200–220 Series (firmware ≤ 3.3-006) and BACnetstac ≤ 4.2.1 only provide FTP and Telnet for device management, and sensitive information (e.g., credentials) communicated through these protocols is sent in cleartext, allowing an attacker to obtain credentials and gain access.
proposal.affected_product: SAUTER Controls Nova 200–220 Series firmware version 3.3-006 and prior; BACnetstac version 4.2.1 and prior

AV.quote: An attacker could obtain sensitive information such as user credentials to gain access to the system.

C.quote: Any sensitive information communicated through these protocols, such as credentials, is sent in cleartext.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm affected firmware and BACnetstac version ranges with vendor, and determine whether encrypted management protocols or mitigations are available; collect packet captures showing cleartext credentials to support severity assessment.
